name: Gasthof Feldwebel
beschreibung: The Gasthof Feldwebel is a traditional hotel in the municipality of Söll in Tirol. The accommodation is centrally located in the village, which allows a short walk to shops and restaurants. The atmosphere is characterized by Tiroler hospitality and cozy furnishings. Guests can expect a restaurant with regional cuisine and a breakfast buffet. The surroundings offer views of the surrounding mountains and the Sölllandl. The amenities include modern rooms with bathroom and some with balcony. A sauna area is available for relaxation after activities. Hiking trails and ski areas are quickly reachable from the house.
